correctness.rationale: The determinant is obtained by exact weighted-matchings expansion on trees and is positive throughout the admissible damping interval by the symmetric random-walk similarity. The adjugate gives exact polynomial PageRank score numerators and the checker verifies their linear systems for all represented trees. Descartes-transformed coefficient signs bound the interior crossing count; 235 eleven-vertex trees and 12,925 pairs are completely enumerated, with 30 candidates resolved using rational Sturm sequences. Three crossing pairs form one automorphism orbit. The explicit degree-six witness polynomial has two certified sign-changing roots. A separate exact matrix inversion verifies four rational parameter values; no finite sample is used as an infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Bressan and Peserico show broad possible rank orders in some graph classes; that general existential claim does not imply or provide a sharp eleven-vertex threshold on trees. Son et al. use directed examples and do not supply the full first undirected-tree layer. The inaccessible full Bressan-Peserico text is a residual risk, not evidence of noncoverage.

value.rationale: A sharp natural finite boundary and complete first exceptional isomorphism layer reveal when equal-degree social-network vertices can swap influence rankings twice under damping. This adds a structural classification, not a routine numerical PageRank instance; it supplies an exact witness and a checkable exhaustive exclusion of every smaller tree.
